title: RBAC v2 rollback safety plan, admin ops, and audit-driven validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Ensure a safe, reversible cutover from RBAC v1 -> RBAC v2 with clear admin controls, real-time audit-driven validation, and a tested rollback path. This ticket owns the operational playbook, admin UIs / API toggles, and the automated validation that proves RBAC v2 is functionally equivalent for customers before final cutover. Scope includes: admin safety controls (kill-switch & scoped rollbacks), audit log assertions for policy equivalence, SSO/SAML mapping smoke checks, dual-write reconciliation helpers, and customer comms/runbook templates for incident & planned rollback scenarios.

Context and constraints: the runtime team is already preparing the dual-write flag (ENG-5784) and the backfill reconciliation pipeline (ENG-6832). This work must not block the backfill but must provide a non-destructive way to revert access state for all tenants if a regression is detected. We cannot do a wholesale DB revert; operational approach must prefer targeted, idempotent reversions scoped by org-id and admin-level.

Decision notes and trade-offs:
- Trade-off: fast cutover vs. conservative staged rollout. We will default to staged rollout with a global kill-switch rather than an immediate global cutover to minimize blast radius.
- Trade-off: synchronous verification vs asynchronous auditing. We will implement both: synchronous smoke checks for each org during canary, and continuous audit-driven checks post-cutover for policy drift detection.
- Security review required: yes. All admin toggles are RBAC-protected and audited.

Non-goals: rewriting the existing migration backfill logic (ENG-6832) or the SSO mapping algorithm – those remain separate tickets. This ticket is about safe ops surface and validation for cutover and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Admin kill-switch toggle exists in Console and via admin API (authz: org-admin + infra role) and records an auditable event for every toggle action.
Scoped rollback API that accepts org_id list and re-applies RBAC v1-equivalent grants for those orgs without mass DB restores.
Automated audit assertions that compare RBAC v1 vs RBAC v2 outcomes for a representative sample of principals and resource types; failing assertions raise alerts to #rbac-cutover and SRE oncall.
Pre-cutover smoke test suite (SSO/SAML login flows, admin panel privilege checks, service-account token flows) passes in the dedicated canary orgs and is runnable via CI job.
Customer comms templates (planned rollouts, rollback notices, post-incident summary) are ready and reviewed by legal/CSM.
Runbook documented with step-by-step rollback play, expected timings, stakeholder notification matrix, and post-rollback verification checklist.
Rehearsal completed with SRE and Security in a dry-run canary and outcomes recorded in the playbook.
Dashboards (consistency, errors, auth-fail rates) show baselines and predefined alert thresholds for cutover window.
Security review completed and sign-off recorded.
Dependencies ENG-5784 and ENG-6832 verified as green for cutover prerequisites.

Add audit-driven assertions: nightly job that compares sample principals across v1/v2 and surfaces diffs -> owner: Observability
Build reconciliation helpers for dual-write drift (idempotent reconcile script + monitoring) -> owner: Migrations
Create Console UX for showing per-org RBAC status and last-synced timestamp -> owner: Console UX
